name: intelthreadlinqs-mcp
description: MCP server for Threadlinqs Intelligence Platform — 73 tools, 25 prompts and 14 resources across threat intel, detections, IOCs, actors, C2, MITRE chains, correlations and Purple-tier composite intelligence

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run build:skill && npm run test:catalog && npm run test:skill
scripts.mcpb:build: npm run build:skill && npm run sync:catalog && npx esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=mcpb-build/server/index.mjs && npx --yes @anthropic-ai/mcpb@2.1.2 pack mcpb-build && mv mcpb-build.mcpb intelthreadlinqs-mcp-$npm_package_version.mcpb

author: Threadlinqs Team
